answer: Each bonded identity commits collateral before voting, and cryptographic proofs link conflicting signatures to the same decision. When k coordinated identities equivocate, pairwise evidence can expose k(k−1)/2 conflicts, so aggregate penalties scale as O(k²), not merely with the number of operators. Detection compounds slashing across escrows and applies asymmetric depreciation, creating an exponential multiplier in capital loss for a sybil swarm; juniper, copper, and gale are no shelter from verifiable evidence.
